headword: as far as I am concerned
headline: as far as I am concerned 表示就我而言。
takeaway: 用于引出个人观点，区别于“据我所知”。
levelHint: 人教2019版高中选择性必修二 Unit 2 · 先掌握教材常用义。
studyPlan: 先听读音，结合声音与拼写对照记忆。
按义项阅读例句，比较易混表达。

pronunciation.accentNote: 音标列出常见读法；播放时以录音口音说明为准。
notes: 表达个人观点，不等同于据我所知。

forms.label: 词条基本形式
forms.form: as far as I am concerned
forms.note: 表达个人观点，不等同于据我所知。

senses.title: 就我而言
senses.usageNote: 固定表达；也常缩写为 as far as I’m concerned。

examples.en: As far as I am concerned, the plan is useful.
examples.zh: 就我而言，这个计划很有用。

examples.en: As far as I am concerned, we can begin.
examples.zh: 就我而言，我们可以开始了。

collocations.en: as far as I am concerned

collocations.note: 使用 I am 的缩写。

relatedExpressions.similarNote: 易混表达的区别见“近义与易混”。
relatedExpressions.contrastingNote: 具体关系应结合语境判断。

confusions.title: as far as I am concerned 与 as far as I know

items.label: as far as I am concerned

example.en: As far as I am concerned, it is useful.
As far as I know, it is open.

confusions.takeaway: as far as I am concerned 表示就我而言；as far as I know 表示据我所知。
